name: Blades of Light and Shadow
source:
Travel with your party of adventurers across the Kingdom of Morella to defeat the forces of the Shadow Court.

Create your character and rally your party in this truly epic adventure! The forces of darkness are rising... will you be the light that defeats them? 

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Blades_of_Light_and_Shadow]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
与冒险者伙伴们一起穿越莫雷拉王国，击败暗影王庭的势力。

在这场真正的史诗冒险中，创建自己的角色，集结你的队伍！黑暗势力正在崛起……你会成为击败它们的那道光吗？

[摘自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Blades_of_Light_and_Shadow]Choices Wikia[/url]]
